mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates by signaling accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% over three months signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not predict negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real retail sales trend over three months signals strong consumer spending, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The rising RSAFS trend does not predict positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 2.0% over three months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and employment declines signal labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in UNRATE and fall in PAYEMS does not predict negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1350.0 indicate strong construction sector activity, supporting consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.0.
